controls: Quiet, fresh, strongly supported and civilian-controlled governments resist this political channel
Actual underfunding and war remain separate
AI pays actual affordable appropriations with no pressure reset, immediate loyalty gift or spending past useful resources
Inspect appropriations and first/repeat events, not merely coup totals

selection: Prefer the smallest candidate that satisfies the joint campaign objectives and controls, with development uncertainty reported. Reject a candidate if controls fail or distribution is improved only by fictitious spending. If all candidates fail, diagnose rather than extending this grid solely to satisfy A1.
interpretation: Development cohort is calibration data, not independent proof. Preserve every candidate result, including failures. No holdout is used for selection.
